rawFindings.title: Incorrect check for _atomics presence in _dirty method
rawFindings.explanation: In the Document.prototype._dirty method, the patch changes the condition from `if (top.value && top.value._atomics && top.value.hasAtomics())` to `if (top.value._atomics && top.value.hasAtomics())` without re-checking if `top.value` is truthy. Removing the `top.value` existence check may cause a runtime error if `top.value` is null or undefined, since it now tries to access `_atomics` directly on possibly null/undefined object.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the check for top.value presence before accessing its properties, for example `if (top.value && top.value._atomics && top.value.hasAtomics())` to avoid possible runtime errors when top.value is falsy.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: If Document.prototype._dirty is called and `top.value` is null or undefined for some dirty paths, the method will throw `TypeError: Cannot read property '_atomics' of null` or `undefined` due to the removed existence check.
